newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Jan jobless rate up to 16.7 pct - SF.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Jan jobless rate up to 16.7 pct - SF.

text.p: The Finnish unemployment rate rose to 16.7 percent in January from 15.1 percent in December, but fell from 17.4 percent in January 1996, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Monday.

Statistics Finland said it had now calculated unemployment according to a slightly revised method, which corresponded better to definitions used by the European Union and the International Labour Organisation ILO.
"According to preliminary studies, the number of employed is slightly bigger and the number of unemployed slightly smaller than under the old method," SF said.
The December jobless rate was revised to 15.1 percent from 15.5 percent according to the old method reported by SF on January 23.
The figures are not seasonally adjusted.
Finland's labour ministry, calculating on a different basis, earlier said the January 1997 unemployment rate fell to 18.5 percent from 19.0 percent in December.
